levels.name: Ringer
levels.says: On the line at the gun, sails the shifts, makes no mistakes

levels.name: Front of the fleet
levels.says: A good start and tidy sailing, a couple of degrees off the best trim

levels.name: Mid-fleet
levels.says: Starts a few lengths late, trims after the shift has gone, overstands a little

levels.name: Back of the fleet
levels.says: Late for the gun, sheets cleated and forgotten, wide round the marks, a reef too late

levels.name: Out for the sunset
levels.says: Still pouring drinks at the gun, steers by the view, never reefs, never sets the spinnaker

mixes.name: Beer can
mixes.says: Mostly mid-fleet and back-markers, with maybe one good boat to chase

mixes.name: Mixed
mixes.says: The whole club: a ringer or two, a solid middle, and the sunset cruisers

mixes.name: Hot fleet
mixes.says: Mostly good boats. Bring your best start

skippers.character: College sailing champion, twenty years ago, and still knows the rule book by number.

lines.mark: Room at the mark! I have an overlap!
lines.passing: Coming through to leeward. Do not bear away.
lines.passed: Protest! I am flying the flag.
lines.finish: First gun is ours. Protest hearing at the bar if anyone objects.

skippers.character: Says very little, misses nothing. Has not been on the wrong side of a shift since 2011.

lines.passed: Nicely sailed. I will have you on the next shift.

skippers.character: Sails every Wednesday without fail and trims like she means it. Wants the ringers' scalps.

lines.start: Wind Dancer is on the line. Let us go!
lines.mark: Clean rounding. Kite up, kite up!
lines.finish: Wind Dancer across. Who is buying?
lines.oops: Do not look at that. Nobody look at that.

skippers.character: Sailmaker by trade. Will tell you what is wrong with your jib leads, kindly, at length.

lines.start: Hard Tack starting. Watch your leech, by the way.
lines.passing: Your jib car wants to come forward two holes.
lines.passed: That mainsail is setting beautifully. Who made it?
lines.finish: Hard Tack finished. Bring your sails round on Saturday.
lines.oops: That was the sail's fault. I should know.

skippers.character: New boat, new sails, matching crew shirts. Very fast whenever it all works.

lines.mark: Rounding. Everyone remember their job, please.
lines.passed: We are still tuning the rig.
lines.finish: Slipstream done. Team photo on the dock.
lines.oops: Which of you was on that winch?

skippers.character: Took up sailing at fifty and has not stopped grinning since. Solid, steady, never first.

lines.start: Second Wind is racing! I think that was the gun.
lines.mark: Round we go. Mind the boom, everyone.
lines.passed: Go on then. Lovely evening for it.
lines.finish: Second Wind is home. What a sail.
lines.oops: Whoops. All part of the learning.

skippers.character: Forty seasons on this water. Goes where the tide tells him and is right more often than not.

lines.start: Goose is away. No rush, the tide does the work.
lines.mark: Round the mark, same as in '84.
lines.passing: Tide line, youngster. You have to read the water.
lines.passed: I had a boat that quick once.
lines.finish: Old Grey Goose, finished, same as every week.
lines.oops: She has never done that before. Forty years.

skippers.character: Four lawyers and a dog. They argue every tack and are surprisingly quick between arguments.

lines.start: Knot Guilty is over the line. Allegedly on time.
lines.passed: We reserve the right to catch you later.
lines.finish: Knot Guilty rests her case. Finished.
lines.oops: The crew would like that struck from the record.

skippers.character: Brings her two teenagers as crew. They are better than she is and all three know it.

lines.mark: Mark rounded. Yes, I saw it, thank you, Freya.
lines.passing: The kids are trimming. That is why.
lines.finish: Pegasus is in. Homework, both of you.
lines.oops: That one was me. I was steering.

skippers.character: Runs the taqueria by the marina. The fastest boat in the fleet when the food is not ready yet.

lines.mark: Round the mark. Who has the salsa?
lines.passing: Light boat tonight. We ate everything already.
lines.passed: Slow down, you will miss dinner.
lines.finish: Tequila Mockingbird finished. Kitchen is open.
lines.oops: Too many cooks on that winch.

skippers.character: Retired schoolteacher. Reads the sailing instructions aloud to the crew, twice, during the start.

lines.start: Slow Motion here. Was that our gun or the five minute?
lines.mark: Is this our mark? It says here it should be to port.
lines.passing: Oh! Are we allowed to pass people?
lines.passed: Well done, dear. Mind how you go.
lines.finish: Slow Motion has finished, I believe. Does someone write it down?

skippers.character: Bought the boat last spring. Has every gadget and is still looking for the mainsheet.

lines.start: Pier Pressure starting. The app says we are early. Or late.
lines.mark: Rounding! Which rope is the blue one?
lines.passing: We are passing someone! Take a photo!
lines.passed: My plotter says we are winning.
lines.oops: That is not what the video said would happen.

skippers.character: Here for the company. Will stop racing to look at a sea lion and consider it time well spent.

lines.start: Lazy Jack is coming. Start without us.
lines.mark: Mark. There was a seal on it. Did you see the seal?
lines.passing: Do not worry, it will not last.
lines.passed: Go get them. We are fine back here.
lines.finish: Lazy Jack is in. Beautiful out there tonight.
lines.oops: We were looking at a pelican.

skippers.character: Wooden-boat man in the wrong fleet. Blames the handicap, though this is one design.

lines.start: Scotch Mist, under way. In my day the gun was a gun.
lines.mark: Rounding. A proper boat would have carried her way.
lines.finish: Scotch Mist finished. I shall be writing to the committee.
lines.oops: The rating does not account for that.

skippers.character: Married fifty-one years. Out for the sunset and the gin. The race is somebody else's business.

lines.start: Happy Hour here. Harold is just finding the ice.
lines.mark: Is that the mark? Harold, is that the mark?
lines.passing: Goodness, Harold, we have overtaken someone.
lines.finish: Happy Hour is finished. Just in time for the second bottle.

skippers.character: Six friends, two coolers, one winch handle. The speaker is louder than the sails.

lines.start: Bottle Opener! We are racing? We are racing!
lines.passed: Nice boat! Want a beer? Catch!
lines.finish: Bottle Opener is DONE. Save us a table.
lines.oops: Who was steering? No, seriously, who was steering?
